'''Dromo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was attacked by a [[Shenbit bonecrusher]] during a safari on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. He was accompanied by his [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] assistant [[Ullumub]] who survived the encounter and offered a reward to those who rescued her employer.
